coordinate_system.all_rects: absolute canvas units unless space is explicit

scaling.input: Raycast only named interactive roots. Art is raycastTarget=false.
scaling.physical_acceptance: 48dp is NOT 48 canvas units. Use actual display density and font scale. Physical phone dp/sp acceptance NOT_RUN.
scaling.large_text: Use large_text_battle when requested text scale >1 or physical minimum body14sp requires >22 canvas units.

fonts.title_family: Hahmlet; fallback existing IBM Plex Sans KR
fonts.numeric: Orbit if already installed; otherwise existing IBM Plex tabular numerals; no new download required

panel.corner_decoration: two 12px brass L marks; never over text

disabled.reason: full text inside button or adjacent persistent reason area; never opacity-fade text

party.ready: brass button + 필살기; show actual gauge value; no fake member HP

enemy.order: existing b.Enemies order, including dead entries

count_1_to_3.root_fill: panel at alpha .22; opaque data panel

data_fields.overflow: horizontal scroller, never replace with ellipsis

enemy.sparse_data: use same data fields; extra area below remains empty
enemy.wrapped_weakness: If weakness preferred height>24, increase weakness height to50 and shift statuses/current/next26px down. If final field exceeds data panel height, use accessible row layout for this encounter.
enemy.sprite_source: assets/enemies/enemy_<enemyDefinitionId>_default_v01.png; map uid to definition id, never parse uid as an asset id
enemy.dead: keep position/name/HP0; art alpha .25; muted contour, 처치 label; root noninteractable; never reflow dead slots
enemy.target: teal 3px border around root, target corner brackets, 선택 text; no flash
enemy.targetable: teal corner brackets only while target step is active; do not recolor HP or weaknesses
enemy.sealed: danger hatching confined to status symbol; keep full status text

art.source: owner sera/harin/nia uses matching approved cutin; common/unknown owner uses plain panel, no invented owner

hand.selected: root y=0, teal border3 + check; retain costs/modes; no fanning/overlap
hand.unplayable: art alpha .25 only; name/cost remain full contrast; full reason in CardActions when selected
hand.overflow: 1308px viewport, horizontal clamped scroll; content=max(1308,count*194-14); no overlapping cards

timeline.fields: group timing + card name / empty / sealed; live count and order unchanged
timeline.overflow: horizontal scroll inside [218,512,1338,48] if computed slot width <180; never drop slots

action_strip.detail: existing action summary sheet retains every row; strip may scroll horizontally; pace changes presentation only

service.option_template: full-width button, title24 and description20; content grows and scrolls rather than clips
service.shop: each existing Shop:<kind>:<id> gets a 1058x132 row, title/detail left736, Info button [752,8,140,52], Buy button [900,64,142,56]; rows retain category order
service.event: EventChoice:<index> full-width 1058xmax(96,measured text height+24), preserve label/cost/effect text

memory.overflow: separate vertical scrollers for before, changes and result; no comma-list truncation
memory.capacity_meter: teal segmented line only if capacity>0; show numeric used/capacity and 용량 초과 text on error

node.all_nodes: preserve every generated node and link; long runs horizontal scroll at minimum column width176
node.icon: vector glyph by node type; see design-spec.md

states.reachable: brass border3 + 갈 수 있음; panel fill
states.visited: brass border1 + check; muted ink label
states.future: line border1 + type label in muted; no false lock symbol

node.connectors: line2; traversed actual history brass3; current-to-reachable teal3; no inferred visits

content.evolution: each existing offer: height=max(128,measured label height+88); label first, branches below; branch width=min(350,(1496-24*(n-1))/n); retain separate Info buttons
content.cards: heading48; three 360x260 RewardCard:<id> at x=20+380*i, y=headingBottom+12; 52px CardInfo:<id> below each; SkipCard [1160,headingBottom+12,356,64]; card selection stays immediate
content.card_art: matching approved owner cutin, header band only at alpha.65; effect/body opaque panel
content.relics: heading40; existing choices in 480x112 cells, gap20; wrap rows if >3
content.part: height112; full part description on left1220, TakePart at right220x56
content.dynamic: sum section heights; empty sections omitted, no placeholder rewards; keep all pending choices available before Proceed

memory_save.validity: use live Core preview/error; do not infer capacity, defeat limit or persistence from art

large_text_battle.trigger: requested font scale115/130 or physical body14sp needs larger than22 canvas units
large_text_battle.party: three rows of min104, grow with measured text/hit area; shared HP remains in fixed PartyStatus

enemy_row.behavior: all rows present, vertical scroll; no promise of five enlarged rows simultaneously on screen

large_text_battle.action_summary: opens existing full result sheet with all pace/reduced/skip controls; label contains last result and pace
large_text_battle.drawer_behavior: temporarily overlays body, not PartyStatus or CardActions; opens without command, selecting card closes drawer, no auto-confirm; hand scrolls horizontally
large_text_battle.header_menu: if original buttons cannot meet48dp, one menu button at[1322,20,246,56] opens deck/log/abandon rows of max(80,converted48dp)
large_text_battle.minimums: body=max(base*fontScale,converted14sp); card effect=max(base*fontScale,converted12sp); hit=max(base,converted48dp). Grow scroller content, never shrink text.
large_text_battle.overflow: if action button needs more than90height, vertical-scroll the action row inside CardActions; preserve every caption/reason
large_text_battle.acceptance: NOT_RUN on Unity/physical device; this is the specified fallback, not implemented game behavior

overlays.input: modal root blocks background; no decorative image intercepts input; preserve prepared-control cancel/info swapped positions and existing no-double-submit behavior

motion.default: optional120ms outline fade; no layout movement except selected card4px
motion.reduced: all static; no parallax, flashes or forced cutins
motion.first_pass: no animation/VFX frames or parallax layers delivered

implementation_boundary: Visual specification only. Unity source, state, balance, selection semantics and memory persistence remain developer-root work.
